entries.zh: 拱候；拱手肃立恭候（候尊长经过）
entries.en: to stand waiting respectfully with clasped hands (stop aside until the superior passes)

entries.zh: 停流；止住水流（使流水停歇）
entries.en: to stop the flow; to check the current of a stream

entries.zh: 尼止；拦止、扣留（使之停住不得离去）
entries.en: to detain him, hold back
entries.notes: 组合罕见，西语栏残损难通（use de algo 不成句）；依'止'字与闽、官音栏取留止义

entries.zh: 阻滞；阻拦羁留、不使离去
entries.en: to obstruct and hold up; to detain, not let (him) go

entries.zh: 停向久；停留很久、久留不去
entries.en: to stay a long time; to linger long

entries.zh: 忍不甘使；忍而不甘、勉强忍受驱使
entries.en: to endure unwillingly; to submit with reluctance
entries.notes: 西语栏（Detenido engañar）与汉字栏不合，疑误读或串行；依汉字'忍不甘使'与闽、官音栏释义

entries.zh: 拘留；拘禁扣留（亦谓被事务缠住、不得脱身）
entries.en: to detain, hold in custody; (pass.) detained, kept occupied

entries.zh: 慨；慨然奋决、慷慨激昂
entries.en: resolute and fervent; generous or indignant in spirit
entries.notes: 单字条目，西语栏尾词难辨（firuuento）；依'慨'本义与闽、官音栏释义

entries.zh: 决；决断、决定（决意行某事）
entries.en: to decide, resolve; determine

entries.zh: 定；决定、定夺（依己意而定）
entries.en: to fix, settle, decide; determine

entries.zh: 懇；诚恳、恳切（恳求）
entries.en: earnest, sincere; to beseech
entries.notes: 西语栏（a lo que conviene）与'懇'常义不合，疑误读；依汉字与闽、官音栏释义

entries.zh: 确；确实、坚决确定（坚实不移）
entries.en: certain, firm; definite

entries.zh: 果敢；果断勇敢（毅然决然行其事）
entries.en: resolute and daring; decisive, courageous

entries.zh: 制度；规章、法度（典章制度）
entries.en: institution, system; regulation
entries.notes: 西语栏（Determinadamte. a la verdad）与汉字栏不合，疑串行；依汉字与闽、官音栏释义

entries.zh: 成去；决意要去、定要前往
entries.en: resolved to go; to go determinedly
entries.notes: 组合罕见；依西语 a ir（前往）与闽、官音栏取'决意去'义

entries.zh: 拘执；固执拘泥、执守不移
entries.en: obstinate adherence; to cling rigidly to rules or opinions
entries.notes: 西语栏（arroja cosa）与汉字栏不合，疑误读；依汉字与闽、官音栏释义

entries.zh: 做峙〔第二字存疑：岫/峙〕；坚定屹立、恒久持守
entries.en: to stand firm, hold constant (second character uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏标[疑:岫/峙]；依西语 constantemente（恒常坚定）取'峙'字挺立持守义

entries.zh: 拙想；思虑拙率、想得轻率
entries.en: to think rashly or clumsily; hasty, inconsiderate thought
entries.notes: 组合罕见；依西语 de ligero（轻率轻忽）与闽、官音栏释义

entries.zh: 偏执；固执己见、偏颇执着（闽稿又作坚执）
entries.en: obstinately biased; to adhere stubbornly (variant 坚执, hold fast)
entries.notes: M 栏并列 piēn chip / giēn chip 两读，与本页 position 21 '坚执'互见

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 四栏无法互证：西语栏残损（ahacera lgr 不成句）、汉字第二字存疑（程/悝）、音栏与'死'字不合，依纪律拒产确定释义

entries.zh: 坚执；坚持执着、坚定持守
entries.en: firm adherence; to persist steadfastly, hold fast
